title: Beware Boiúna
overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

title: Baththa
overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two, changing their lives forever.

title: Dust
overview: Sam's curiosity about life and death deepens on a family backpacking trip, where we see nature, loss, and the cycle of existence through the lens of a six-year-old child.

title: Cars: Spooky Halloween Adventure
overview: It's Halloween night in Radiator Springs, and Lightning and his best friend Mater are enjoying the festivities at the annual spooky block party. But when Lightning gets bored of the flavored gasoline, roasted lug nuts, and jack-cone-lanterns, he convinces Mater to check out the old haunted garage on the edge of town. Will the two friends be brave enough to make it through the night without getting spooked?

title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
overview: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

title: No, Chef!
overview: A young aspiring chef must convince his father to let him bake his passion cake as the death of his mother looms over the family.

title: Erie
overview: Siblings Stella and Oscar return to their Pennsylvania hometown to investigate their sister Iris' unexplained death following a mysterious rise in suicides within the county.

title: Downtown
overview: In 1988, three young gay men, Ronnie, Lennart and Bas, throw themselves into Amsterdam's nightlife  scene. It’s a life full of friendship, sex and drugs. Until the mysterious AIDS virus casts a shadow over their  lives and one of them disappears after becoming infected. Thirty-two years later, in the middle of the 2021  lockdown, Ronnie recognises the missing Bas in the subway. An evening unfolds that none of them had  expected to see, but which had been in the air for years. The AIDS epidemic has had a major impact on all  three of their lives. Where they lost each other 32 years ago, they hope to find each other again.

title: A Bit of Light
overview: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.

title: Traces of Justice
overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

title: Thella Kaagitham
overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Pardon
overview: Middle-aged couple Shen Mo and Tian Yi, facing their third seven-year itch, see their marriage erupt in a bitter clash of accumulated frustration, culminating in a 30-day cooling-off period that seems destined to conclude their relationship.

title: Bayang
overview: Ayu (16) becomes obsessed with the beauty standards she sees in social media and magazines. Covering her mirror with notes about what it means to be “beautiful,” she pushes herself to change her appearance through makeup, dieting, and other painful efforts. As her reflection disappears behind these expectations, so does her sense of self. Overwhelmed, Ayu escapes to the beach, where an unexpected encounter with the girl she idolizes challenges her beliefs and reveals a different understanding of beauty and self-acceptance.

title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

title: Chimera
overview: A shocking revelation forces a widow to wrestle with her conscience over whether to release her late husband’s final novel.

title: Reform Zara
overview: John Galliano’s process of reworking garments for Zara unfolds alongside theatrical tableaux suspended between past and future. Intimate conversations and observations of dressmaking reveal how a pocket alters posture, an opening changes movement, and clothing becomes character. Moving between documentary and fiction, the film explores imagination, memory and authorship through the transformation of familiar forms.

title: 111 Echoes from Halifax
overview: Traces the stories of characters affected by the Swissair flight 111 crash, which happened off the coast of Nova Scotia, near the entrance of Margaret’s Bay, on September 2, 1998.

title: Watching People Watching Birds
overview: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

title: The Opera!
overview: The Three Chaps; Prescott, Chogurt, and Dr. Wilbert, await to see Lady Hogsmash LIVE at The Opera. While appreciating some lobby art, a horrific travesty unfolds, leaving The Chaps to wonder if they'll make it out of The Opera House on a high note.

title: Repo
overview: After his last job went wrong, local fixer John is trying to get out of the game. His criminal boss, Indiana Slim, refuses to give John his final payment unless he does one final job, leaving John with two options: complete one last job, or leave empty handed

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Infirmary
overview: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: The Last First: Winter K2
overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

title: The Brainstorm
overview: Rosalie tries to make a film, while her roommate and her actors keep getting in her way.

title: Orion
overview: A NASA interrogator is tasked with helping an amnesiac astronaut recover his memory in order to determine “who” or “what” killed the rest of the crew before they crash-landed back on Earth.

title: Street Fighters
overview: The world’s best martial artists come together for a world championship organised by a mysterious organisation. As alliances are forged and enemies emerge, they soon realise there’s more at stake than the grand prize… their lives!

title: Riptides
overview: A daughter's diabolical plan to preserve her father's legacy is torpedoed by a demented boogie boarder on a self-help bender. A dark tropical comedy about dreams and delusions.

title: French Fries
overview: Years after abandoning the film they once dreamed of making together, two old friends reunite on the set of a television series. As they prepare french fries in a trailer, memories, old ambitions and long-buried disappointments resurface. Their conversation gradually becomes a confrontation with the choices, compromises and excuses that have shaped their lives, raising a simple question: Do we give up on our dreams because we change, or do we change because we give up on our dreams?

title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

title: Nickels
overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

title: The Influencer Project
overview: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

title: Avaraachan & Sons
overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

title: Anbil Avan
overview: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

title: Bite Size Terror
overview: A bite-sized horror anthology where seemingly harmless encounters, desires, and decisions take terrifying turns.

title: Appofeniacs
overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

title: Sigma
overview: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

title: The Wealth
overview: In an Anatolian city, Mr. Mehmet, a wealthy and respected merchant, is approaching death. As his condition worsens, family members and acquaintances begin gathering around him. Beneath the quiet atmosphere of the house, long buried tensions, unspoken expectations, and hidden ambitions slowly emerge. Through silences, gestures, and fragile relationships, The Wealth explores the emotional and moral fractures created by inheritance, family ties, and the inevitability of death.

title: The Children of Kozara
overview: Based on the novel of Arsen Diklić which describes the horrors of concentration camp Jasenovac.

title: Cyclone
overview: A transgender woman from mainland China travels to Hong Kong with a single, urgent goal: to undergo gender-affirming surgery. Moving through the city in a state of emotional suspension, she navigates temporary lodging, medical bureaucracy, and fleeting encounters with strangers who alternately offer intimacy, indifference, or quiet solidarity. As the date of the operation approaches, her journey becomes less about the procedure itself than about the weight of expectation, fear, and self-recognition.

title: Method
overview: After watching grief transform her classmate into a brilliant actor, an ambitious student wonders what she’s missing. "Method" is a darkly funny satire about jealousy, grief, and how far artists will go for authenticity.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Shakira Live from Madrid
overview: This musical release from pop singer Shakira captures a live performance by the artist, recorded live in Madrid. Proudly presented by Amazon Music.

title: Claddagh
overview: Two sisters struggle to decide whether their deceased mother would like to be buried with her favorite Claddagh necklace, or leave it with them as an heirloom. The wrong decision could prove more devastating than either imagined.

title: Go for Broke 2
overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

title: Marge
overview: After learning she’s pregnant, Sadie reflects back on the night she learned her mother was a serial killer. But now becoming a mother herself, Sadie suddenly finds herself understanding Marge in a way she never has before.

title: Mimic
overview: Amid the heightening ICE raids across Los Angeles, a Filipino Man visits his estranged sister’s home and makes a terrifying discovery.

title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

title: Father Father
overview: Khader and Aviv, a Muslim-Jewish gay couple, dream of starting a family. Yet, amid the joy of pregnancy and the rise of far-right extremism and war propaganda, they are forced to confront a difficult question: What does it mean to bring a child into a world torn by conflict?

title: Fatherhood
overview: Devoted soon-to-be father Lee grapples with work-family balance and self-doubt, but a surprising connection with a regular customer awakens a longing for the fatherly bond he never had.

title: A Shonda
overview: “A Shonda” is a short ritual art film filmed in the holy days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. Two transsexual Jews commune with the dead, reimagine gendered cultural practices, and attempt to atone for the sins committed in their name.

title: Gasmask
overview: Fifteen years after the fall of civilization, the last remnants of humanity are left to survive in a world without electricity. When a solar-powered generator opens up new frontiers for discovery, our narrator starts recording his memories using an old phone, and a group of artists — a musician, a storyteller, and a dancer — utilize the electricity to bring their creative impulses to life. Suddenly, members of a generation shaped by the apocalypse are able to scavenge through old smartphones like relics of a vanished civilization, discovering pictures of cats and fragments of forgotten music from a world they never knew.

title: Tarik
overview: A boy named Ridho lives a simple life alongside his father, helping him sell vegetables each day. Amid the relentless demands of daily life, he discovers a modest sense of happiness through a handmade kite. For the very first time, he possesses something that offers him true release from the burdens he carries.  Yet for his father, manhood is defined by utility being useful, capable, and needed. Consequently, flying a kite is dismissed as trivial next to the duties that lie ahead. To Ridho, however, happiness and freedom are the very essence of what he requires.  As their values collide, Ridho must navigate a choice between clinging to his newly found joy or conforming to the life his father considers best for him.

title: Matchbox the Movie
overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

title: The Bridge
overview: Young Israeli survivors of the October 7 attacks travel to Los Angeles for Rock ’n’ Roll Fantasy Camp, discovering healing and strength through music and shared resilience.

title: Damilola Taylor: The Untold Story
overview: Ten-year-old Damilola Taylor was fatally stabbed in 2000 in a stairwell in Peckham, South East London, just metres from his home. 'Star Wars' star John Boyega, who also grew up in Peckham, speaks for the first time about being one of the last people to see him alive, sharing the fear and uncertainty that followed in the aftermath of Taylor's death. Boyega is joined by close friends and family members of Taylor, who reveal the events that led to his death and talk for the first time about the impact his tragic murder has had in shaping their lives.

title: Lippenstift
overview: Tomorrow is the funeral of Benedicte’s stepfather. She is 43, a psychologist, and a mother. She has to deal with her children’s anxieties about what to wear, see her patients before leaving, prepare sandwiches for the trip, and put up with her husband’s sarcasm. So far, she’s holding it together.

title: Hurricane
overview: Manuel, a young filmmaker, seeks help from his friend Facundo to develop his script. Together they make the story come to life and the characters become independent. However, at the end, different possible paths arise that strain their relationship.

title: Heaven
overview: After flatlining in the hospital, young April learns paradise is a LOT wilder than she'd thought.

title: Decision 2026: Battle for Control of Congress
overview: With less than a month to the 2026 midterm elections, in this NBC News special report, Kristen Welker, Hallie Jackson, and Steve Kornacki examine what's at stake for both parties as they battle for control of Congress and what polling says across the United States.

title: Last Chance Motel
overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

title: Madonna:  MTV VMAS 2026 - Behind the Scenes
overview: The making of Madonna's performance with Sabrina Carpenter and Charli xcx at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards.

title: Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: Love of Your Life
overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Vampire Carnival
overview: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

title: All Yours
overview: After discovering her skin is peeling off, a bored mother is compelled to bake it into little pastries.

title: Видеопрокат
overview: The steady, uneventful life of Roma, a lonely ninth-grader, is disrupted by Polina—a rebellious older student who is constantly getting into wild escapades. Together, they attempt to unravel the mystery of a mystical VHS tape—number seven—rented from a local video store. Drawn into a dangerous adventure and growing genuinely close, they have no idea what kind of choice the investigation’s conclusion will force them to make.

title: All About Corinne
overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

title: Too Many Beasts
overview: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

title: Who Is Martin Mull?
overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

title: Angel and the Badman
overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

title: The Beast
overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

title: Therapy Done Right
overview: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

title: The Spiral
overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

title: Disconnected
overview: Centers around the Walker family as they navigate personal loss and the consequences of online manipulation. Set against the backdrop of a school system heavily reliant on technology, the Walker’s and a group of courageous students challenge a corrupt administration as they fight to reclaim their community and their lives.

title: Wake
overview: Four semi-estranged siblings who reunite for their father’s wake, only to clash with his overbearing side of the family in a tug-of-war over how to say goodbye. As oblivious guests and a death-phobic funeral director add to the chaos, they fumble into an absurd new reality – one that, maybe, just maybe, could bring them closer together.

title: JTÉPARAKONTÉ - Ophélie
overview: RAPHAËL and SAM are having an argument about things that make us special. He decides to bring her into his memories to show her why he believes he is so special.

title: Found Alive
overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: Šipkaři
overview: The Darts Players combine black humour, action and a crime plot with a healthy dose of absurdity. Their world is full of characters who have their own agendas, are hiding something and are convinced that they, of all people, have everything under control. The main character, Pepé, believes that this time it will finally work out. All he needs to do is make a few right decisions, find the right people, not panic and, above all, not mess anything up. But his life has never quite gone to plan. When he meets Milánek again after a year, a series of events unfolds that nobody could have foreseen.

title: La casa
overview: After many years working for a multinational company, Hugo Vaca is laid off and must face the harsh reality of the job market. On the verge of despair, he connects through a friend with a group of investors who offer to buy his house, valued at one million dollars, at 50 percent of its value, but with usufruct rights until his death. Cornered by reality, he accepts the deal, but things end up becoming much more complicated than he expected.

title: Raw Plan
overview: When Christina returns as a teacher to the school where she was once a student herself, she carries with her a past she thought was long over. In the classroom she is confronted with the problematic Mathilde, 16, who has lived in a shelter since her mother's death. Their meeting sets off a power struggle that quickly grows beyond the classroom walls. Mathilde struggles to hold on to a world that is falling apart around her, while Christina struggles not to become who she once was. Harassment, secrets and lies pull them towards a darkness neither of them can control.

title: The Pastor Who Preys
overview: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.

title: Rough Draft
overview: Much to his wife’s chagrin, Michael can’t seem to settle on the ending to his latest novel. Even though he has owed the publisher for some time now, he keeps deleting and tweaking the ending to his tale of horror, with each change ultimately affecting the outcome of the group of teens who are being killed one by one by an unknown killer in his story.

title: Nobody's Violence
overview: Follows a travelling girl offering euthanasia services in a dystopian world.

title: Zustìssia
overview: Set among the mountains of southern Sardinia, Zustissia reconstructs the 1991 triple homicide that led to Zuncheddu being sentenced to life imprisonment. He spent 33 years in prison before being definitively acquitted on 26 January 2024, following a retrial initiated by lawyer Mauro Trogu.

title: Rider
overview: Saluele, known as Sami, is a young fiid delivery rider who spends his days cycling across Milan travelling from one end of the city to the other. On New Year's Eve, while the city bursts into celebration, beneath dazzling lights, he delivers a huge sushi order to a luxorious villa on the city's northern outskirts. Invited to stay for the evening, Sami meets Nia, and the two instantly form a powerful connection. But as a new romance begins to blossom, an impulsive decision will have fatal consequences, forcing Sami to decide whether to face the consequences of his actions.

title: It Was All Her!
overview: Talented as a child but completely lost in her thirties, Vasya suddenly realizes she's heading for rock bottom and has no strength to escape. Malvina, an imaginary friend from childhood, comes to his aid, a freakish woman with purple hair and a quirky sense of humor. Malvina pushes Vasya to find her childhood love, Stasik. Vasya will go through a long journey and understand what went wrong in her life, but most importantly, she will learn why Malvina appeared.

title: Fernanda
overview: A portrait of one of Brazil’s greatest actresses, centered on the one thing inseparable from her identity: her craft. The documentary follows Fernanda Montenegro through her most recent work while looking back at the past to trace the making of a great actress over the course of her career. Directed by Pedro Waddington, son of filmmaker Andrucha Waddington—Fernanda’s son-in-law—the film embraces their family relationship as part of its narrative, capturing intimate moments with the actress backstage and unveiling previously unseen footage of projects made together as a family.

title: Las Hijas
overview: A twenty-year-old girl wakes up in a house in the woods after a night of partying. Three young women greet her as the daughters of her kidnapper. They too were kidnapped, and their isolation led them to embrace this community as idyllic.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Reporting Live
overview: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

title: Tenzing
overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
overview: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

title: Musk
overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded 'inventor-entrepreneur' who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Yorushika LIVE: "Tousaku"
overview: A concept live performance by n-buna, combining recitation and musical performance, held from September to October 2025.  This video features footage from Yorushika's LIVE TOUR 2025 "Plagiarism Re-enactment".

title: You, Like a Star
overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

title: Apocalypse Z: New World
overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

title: Devour
overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

title: Ashes
overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
overview: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
overview: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

title: Teambuilding 2
overview: After barely surviving a team-building retreat that tested not only their social skills but also their mental health, Horia and the gang are now part of an elite team trying to sell a groundbreaking new product: AI de PLM.

title: Center Stage for Murder
overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.

title: Arriba Tutto
overview: A seven-year-old boy's magical childhood with his street performer father ends tragically. Years later, he struggles with anger and bitterness, having lost the joy and wonder he once knew.

title: Comrade Kalyan
overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
overview: This epic documentary reveals how bold artistic choices, behind-the-scenes conflicts, and groundbreaking ideas came together to create an enduring television classic. Through exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, The Sixty-Year Mission uncovers that truth is indeed stranger than science-fiction.

title: Jean-Jacques Goldman : 50 ans dans le cœur des Français
Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
overview: The general public discovered Bilal Hassani during Eurovision 2019 with his song "Roi" (King), a true anthem to diversity that sparked waves of both love and hatred on social media. Very quickly, the young man courageously tackled the question of gender identity in a personal and artistic exploration, not hesitating to share his doubts, his wounds, and his own evolution with us. This documentary sets out to embrace several deeply resonant themes: homosexuality, homophobia, cyberbullying and justice, racism as well as Moroccan roots, love and the choice of a mother who frees herself from cultural weight for her son's fulfillment, celebrity, and of course, identity and gender.

title: Ateş
overview: After his older brother, Chief Inspector Ali, is killed in the line of duty, Special Forces Major Ateş sets out to uncover the shadowy organization responsible for his death. As his investigation brings him closer to the truth, he faces increasingly dangerous challenges that threaten both his personal life and military career. Driven by grief and a desire for justice, Ateş finds himself caught in a growing conflict between doing what is right and seeking revenge.

title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Wilder
overview: Focusing on the life and legacy of actor Gene Wilder, told through the lens of Jordan Walker-Pearlman, the late actor’s nephew and a filmmaker in his own right.

title: Adult Supervision
overview: Three fathers accompany their teenage daughters on a school trip to a remote island. What begins as a peaceful getaway soon turns into a series of unexpected problems. Each father has a different approach to parenting, influenced by his own past experiences, and their conflicting views create tension among them. As the situation becomes increasingly difficult to control, memories of their past return and force them to confront their mistakes and shortcomings. The trip ultimately leaves them questioning who is really in control.

title: Dead Company
overview: The official hand-animated movie for Royal Blood's third single and title track of their fifth album.

title: Olivia Rodrigo: Austin City Limits
overview: GRAMMY Award-Winning Multi-Platinum ‪Olivia Rodrigo‬ Takes the ACL Stage Five Years After Her Debut with First Full-Set Performance of Chart-Topping Album "you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love".

title: The Monster She Married
overview: Groomed since she was a teen, a woman confronts the dark truth about her husband, the man she once trusted as her pediatrician. When another one of his patients is murdered just days before testifying against him, she must break her silence.

title: Buff
overview: After being released from jail for climate activism, a woman encounters an abused rodeo buffalo for which she will trek the American southwest in an attempt to free it and herself. Starring Jena Malone (The Hunger Games series, The Neon Demon) and Joshua Close (Killers of the Flower Moon, Fargo TV series).

title: Wake
overview: After committing murder and disposing of the evidence, Ellie (Natasha Lockhart) seeks help in therapy following the tragic event in hope it destroys the sound, pain and fear she has since experienced. The mind is a powerful thing and her own...Let's say it has a mind of its own. Wake marks Leon's debut as an independent writer and director!'  Starring: Natasha Lockhart

title: The Spirit of Halloween
overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

title: Loved One
overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
overview: The 2026 Money in the Bank, also promoted as Money in the Bank: New Orleans, is an upcoming professional wrestling premium live event produced by WWE. It will be the 17th annual Money in the Bank event and will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. This will be the first Money in the Bank to be held in October, making it the latest scheduled Money in the Bank in a calendar year, and the first one to be held after SummerSlam.

title: Calamity Wayne
overview: In 1960s Belfast, timid ten-year-old Wayne hopes to impress his crush, Annette. Named after Western star John Wayne, he must summon his own courage when a bully challenges him to a showdown at the local cinema.

title: A Second Chance Christmas
overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

title: Too Soon
overview: A Second Shot at love comes sooner than expected for a young widow and widower who meet the day of their spouses' funerals.

title: Termination Point
overview: An alcoholic is faced with her inner demons after sleeping past her stop home on the bus.

title: Beach Fictions
overview: On a train, a novelist meets Tae-ju, a young woman who resembles the protagonist of her novel in progress. Tae-ju runs away from damaging rumors to a seaside town. There, she meets Man-hyuk, a street magician, and feels drawn to him—only to hear unsettling rumors about him. Unsure of what to believe, Tae-ju visits a fortune-teller mentioned as being remarkably accurate.

title: New Silence
overview: A rhythmic portrait of the search for connection between a reclusive drummer and his sister. Overwhelmed by the rumbling vibrations of a fragmented winter landscape, the tormented brother refuses to speak. His sister tries to break his silence by communicating indirectly through audio clips, using her brother’s sound recorder to create an auditive universe for their relationship.

title: Harvest
overview: It’s Christmastime. Claire struggles to leave her “safe” Brooklyn studio where social media, 24-hr news, and AI are her only companions. Pushed to her breaking point, she reluctantly accepts help from her AI assistant “ChatAPP,” who promises a relationship that only the infinite bounds of a digital world can provide.

title: Dulle Griet
overview: We live a miserable life and one day we die. Marguerite’s body is found lifeless. She awakens in an underground world populated by strange figures. On the surface, her granddaughter Odile struggles to find meaning in life. The two women connect mysteriously through Brueghel’s Dulle Griet. As a museum guide explains the painting to visitors, its elements begin to come alive in both women’s realities. The struggle never truly ends. But if life is to be worth anything, we must fight for it.

title: Day Ones
overview: On a trip to his hometown, Quail Feather’s son goes missing. In order to find him, he must reconnect with the only ones he can trust with the task… his DAY ONES.

title: Remain Calm
overview: The story follows the two gas station clerks whose routine night shift turns into a fight for survival. A government agent warns them about Mr. Frett, a terrifying creature that tracks and hunts people who show any signs of anxiety, stress, or panic. To stay alive, the characters must force themselves into a state of aggressive positivity and calm.

title: Clown Panic
overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

title: Always Lalisa
overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
overview: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.

title: Fresh Meat
overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

title: JINX
overview: A married couple discovers how dangerous it is to be too much like your partner.

title: The Walk
overview: Kevin has a terrible, horrible, no good, very bad day.

title: Tchotchke
overview: After finding a strange, clown-shaped coin bank, a man is disturbed by visions that are only silenced by feeding it coins. As his fixation grows, he sacrifices everything to appease it.

title: TRY
overview: Sam arrives at the wake of his closeted boyfriend, Joe, who has recently passed away. When taking a quiet moment, Sam is unexpectedly joined by Joe's mother, Tia, who has no idea who he is.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: The Exit State
overview: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.

title: Let's Have Kids!
overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

title: John Simpson - 60 Years at the BBC
overview: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon.

title: Repo! This Movie: The Anatomy of a Cult
overview: Featuring insights from director Darren Lynn Bousman and cast members, a look at how the dark, cybergoth rock opera Repo! The Genetic Opera – originating from a modest theatrical stage play – blended industrial goth aesthetics, high-camp operatic numbers, and comic-book gore into an enduring midnight-movie cult classic. The feature-length documentary highlights the grassroots fan movement, shadowcasts, and interactive community gatherings, ala The Rocky Horror Picture Show.

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Jailer 2
overview: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

title: 2 Valid IDs
overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

title: Minotaur
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: Les Misérables
overview: After enduring 19 years in prison for stealing a loaf of bread, Jean Valjean emerges a hardened man. He seeks redemption by reinventing himself as a respected dignitary under a new identity. He promises Fantine, a dying factory worker, to rescue and protect her daughter Cosette, who is being exploited and mistreated by the deceitful Thénardier family. As Valjean raises Cosette as his own, he is relentlessly pursued by Inspector Javert. Admist the social unrest shaking France, the fates of Valjean, Cosette, her lover Marius, and Javert become intertwined in a turbulent, revolutionary Paris. Through struggles, sacrifices, and a deep yearning for justice, Valjean strives to complete his journey of redemption and offer Cosette a future of love and freedom.

title: Pee Mak
overview: Mak, a soldier returning home from war, invites four of his comrades to meet his wife and newborn child. However, suspicion soon grows among his friends as they uncover a terrifying secret: Mak’s family is no longer among the living.

title: Doubt
overview: A couple of months away from his ordination, young Catholic deacon Jean decides to briefly join a remote monastery in Luxembourg to decide whether he’s more suited to monastic life. His days are spent in prayer, ritual, choir practice, and quiet observation of the peaceful life there. However, the arrival of a visitor, an attractive young man who also happens to be a benefactor to the monastery, awakens unsettling feelings Jean struggles to identify. Soon, Jean is forced to confront his convictions, but also the very foundation of his sense of belonging.

title: Little Miss Sun Sign
overview: As the camera orbits him, Joey Frank struggles to convey an idea about astrology to a rotating group of guests. In 2006, in a manic episode in a matinee of Little Miss Sunshine, Joey Frank had an epiphany that he attempts to recreate by watching the film again. 14 hours of stopping and starting gets boiled and trimmed down to 101 minutes, so that Little Miss Sun Sign is the same length and size as the film from whence it came.

title: METEORIT
overview: A foreigner comes to a Moldovan village looking for a meteorite that fell nearby, as life there flows at its own pace.

title: Brianza
overview: Set against the backdrop of the 2009 economic crisis, Brianza follows Giorgio Farina, the heir to a historic gun shop who faces ruin after a failed luxury investment in Switzerland. Desperate to save his social standing, he enters into a dangerous partnership with eccentric businessman Alberto Fumagalli. What begins as an illicit scheme quickly plunges Giorgio into a downward spiral of debt, crime, and peril, threatening his family, his reputation, and his life.

title: The Scarecrow
overview: It's summer. Alexandre is 10 years old and is taking part in his village's annual scarecrow competition with his friends. But not everyone likes his creation...

title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Three
overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have released the third part of their Philadelphia Freedom Cut project, sharing official video of the next eight songs from their Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour finale: “House of a Thousand Guitars," "My City of Ruins," "Because the Night," "Wrecking Ball," "The Rising," "The Ghost of Tom Joad," "Badlands" and "Land of Hope and Dreams."

title: Ranabaali
overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

title: The Storm
overview: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.

title: Redemption River
overview: Stranded after a rafting accident, a couple on the brink of collapse must come together to escape the unforgiving wilderness.

title: Hard Feelings
overview: What begins as an intimate date at her home quickly takes a bizarre and increasingly dangerous turn when she discovers that Brian isn’t exactly the man she thought she invited over. As the night spirals into a strange mix of romance, dark comedy, and horror, Jane is forced to confront the unsettling truth about her date — and figure out just how far she’s willing to go to survive a night of hard feelings.

title: Half
overview: A mixed Japanese and Caucasian woman reflects on identity, belonging and the responsibilities and biases that accompany her background.

title: Notturna
overview: Nico, a young man from the outskirts trapped in the drug dealing world, unexpectedly finds a way out when he retrieves a bag abandoned by two guys fleeing from the police.

title: Youri
overview: Amsterdam, 1982. When journalist Jan Brokken meets Youri Egorov – the world-famous Soviet pianist who fled his homeland because of his sexuality – an unexpected friendship begins. Jan, quiet and guarded, is drawn to Youri’s brilliance, excess and freedom; Youri, in turn, recognizes in Jan a kindred outsider. As their bond deepens, Youri inspires Jan the courage to pursue the life he has always postponed: becoming a writer.

title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
overview: A cop tries to track down Bikram Pramanik, a master of disguise whose wife is a pickpocket.

title: Home, Almost
overview: A story about an MMA fighter who finds himself in another fight on the way home. — with his father and younger brother by his side, finding the true meaning of family along the way.

title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
overview: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

title: Synthetic
overview: The film is based on real-life events. Alena, a voice-over star, suddenly discovers that her voice has been stolen by the developers a major bank's neural network. Now her voice can be heard everywhere—from airport announcements to entertainment and gaming platforms. Alena realizes that in the modern reality a person's voice does not fall under legal protection. Thus, not only voice-over actors but everyone is at risk. The actress starts a struggle for the right to her own voice.

title: Je so’ pazzo
overview: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.

title: Grad Night
overview: A graduation tape from the Class of 2001 captures one last night of freedom and the beginning of a relationship that will shape a lifetime.

title: Encryption
overview: A conspiracy theorist Theo and his niece are looking for answers about Theo's abduction. Following a path of clues left by Theo prior to his memory loss leads them to a hideout of an underground organization nicknamed "Cryp-Tech".

title: Masterplan
overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

title: You Can See Everything
overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

title: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
overview: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

title: Seriously Single Too
overview: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.

title: Nayyi Navelli
overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

title: Clean Hands
overview: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

title: Cabaret Boys
overview: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

title: Goody Goody
overview: During a prolonged home birth trapped by a raging blizzard, expecting parents and their midwife begin to suspect something sinister is lurking nearby as labor complications escalate and their sense of safety unravels.

title: Devices
overview: With his wife gone for the night, a new father's first solo parenting venture becomes a nightmare.

title: You Can't Leave
overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

title: mentor
overview: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.

title: Her Song
overview: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: DeSu7
overview: After years apart, two people reunite for a fresh start. A story of deep emotion, romance, and action about love that endures and a reunion destined to happen.

title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
overview: Hyper organized single mom and party planner Lexi, her free-spirited mother June, and teen daughter Piper are set to spend Christmas at a local ski resort after Lexi is hired to organize their annual holiday party. Upon arrival, she immediately butts heads with Ridge, the ski instructor and son of the lodge's owner, Dan.

title: Submissive Homeland
overview: Brazil truly has the "secret sauce," and people from the outside are taking notice.  While Trump, in the United States, has his eyes on our mineral wealth, Flávio Bolsonaro—a candidate for the Brazilian presidency—is promising to hand over our rare earth elements in an attempt to win an election.  In this episode, we interview General Santos Cruz, a former minister under Jair Bolsonaro, who states: this is not what it means to be right-wing, nor is it patriotic—it is complete submission. Our minerals are strategic, both for us and for the world. The question that remains is: who will own this wealth in the years to come? Will you just sit by while it’s handed over to Trump on a silver platter?

title: In Dreaming
overview: Ryan is destined to dance, but has to put his passion aside to fulfil his duties at his family’s nail salon.

title: Yale
overview: A troubled woman must confront her deadbeat father who abandoned her as a child as the last-ditch effort to find a donor kidney for her dying son.

title: My Love For You Is Deep But the Devil Loves Me Deeper
overview: Alice, a young woman shattered by heartbreak after being dumped from her nebbish boyfriend Ryan, encounters the Devil and makes a deal for “all the love in the world.”

title: Black Water
overview: 19-year-old Noah, who's living with his mom and sister in an old, dilapidated house on the outskirts of Boston, is sitting in therapy, as he's suffering from dark and potentially dangerous visions at night. During one of his sessions, he's asked to revisit some of these visions, forcing him back to a time of horror and distress.

title: The Face
overview: 17-year-old Joel, a recently recruited night guard, watches over a compound marked by cartel violence. When the darkness begins to whisper, he realizes some secrets never die.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
overview: When ambitious freelance reporter Avery Clark returns to Chicago to spend Christmas with her mom and new stepdad, she's hoping for a little holiday downtime before her next assignment. Instead, she lands a feel-good story profiling Darlene Donnelly, a beloved Chicago Bears superfan about to celebrate an incredible milestone: attending her 500th game. There's just one catch: Avery knows next to nothing about football or Chicago. Enter Darlene's handsome grandson Matt, a Chicago firefighter and die-hard Bears fan who, with a little gentle nudging from Darlene, agrees to show Avery what being a part of Bears Nation is all about.

title: Super Scam Me
overview: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

title: The Metropolitan Opera: Macbeth
overview: Two of opera’s most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi’s thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Following past triumphs in many of Verdi’s signature baritone roles, Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite Lise Davidsen—the world’s reigning dramatic soprano—as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske, a brilliant young director making waves around the world. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as the heroic Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Macbeth’s friend-turned-victim Banquo. This live cinema transmission is part of The Met: Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.

title: The Last Fellini
overview: Much has been told about Federico Fellini, but one chapter remains largely unexplored. It is the final decade of his life and artistic career. During the 1980s and 1990s, the film industry celebrated him while struggling to support his visions. The Maestro never stopped creating and fought to continue expressing himself. Sharing his dreams and extraordinary energy were exceptional companions: Roberto Benigni, Martin Scorsese, Nicola Piovani, Vincenzo Mollica, Milo Manara, and his inseparable secretary, Fiammetta Profili. Ultimo Fellini reveals the man behind the icon through three years of research, private archives, and previously unseen footage, beginning with the precious materials of Vincenzo Mollica.

title: Silver Bells at Christmas
overview: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.

title: Unleashed Spirits: The Rise of the Hollywood Vampires
overview: A documentary explores the formation and journey of the rock supergroup, the Hollywood Vampires.

title: Mi casa no es tu casa
Cathexis
overview: In a forgotten Florida panhandle town, a lonely young woman responsible for a murder becomes fixated on inhabiting the mind of the case’s detective as fantasy and reality begin to blur.

title: Big Phan
overview: For nearly 50 years, two unseen masters of their craft—Dave Raymond and Tom Burgoyne— have brought to life the Phillie Phanatic, a character they had to become if they were ever going to become themselves.

title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
overview: The ultimate love letter to Martin Scorsese's classic film GoodFellas (1990).

title: People Watching
overview: When a restless young woman starts fixating on a mysterious car parked outside of her apartment, the night takes a dangerous turn.

title: Just After Dawn
overview: Returning from the Atlas lunar mission, the astronauts discover an Earth where humanity has vanished. Cut off from everything, they find themselves confronted with an unfathomable mystery that defies reason.. and threatens their very existence.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
overview: Taylor Lewis, a single father and expert in holiday displays, moves to the picturesque town of Pineway with his two children just weeks before Christmas. While the family adjusts to a new home and school, Taylor also faces the realization that his teenage daughter may be growing out of some of their treasured Christmas traditions.  When Taylor becomes involved in reviving Pineway's Christmas Market, he's paired with Sophie Shaw, a practical accountant eager to prove herself as a potential leader. Their different approaches soon complement each other, bringing new life and festive spirit to the town.  As Taylor tries to hold onto the Christmas traditions his family once shared, he discovers that meaningful moments can't simply be recreated. Growing closer to Sophie along the way, he begins to see that embracing change can lead to new traditions, new memories, and perhaps an unexpected new beginning.

title: Being Ben
overview: With his NBA career getting a restart this season with the Sacramento Kings, former No. 1 draft pick Ben Simmons opens up in a new ESPN E60 documentary about the highs and lows of his extraordinary career, his attempt to reclaim his place in the game – and his lifelong passion for fishing.

title: A Story She Told
overview: The return of an old love quietly fractures a filmmaker's celebratory night, as a private past begins to reveal itself in the story she chose to tell.

title: Le'a
overview: On Oʻahu, a college student’s suppressed desire for her best friend forces them both on a sugar daddy date with a wealthy ex-military man turned artist, where desire and power unravel each other.

title: Le ragazzine stanno perdendo il controllo. La società le teme. La fine è azzurra.
Shark Lake
overview: A couple travel to a remote hotel hoping to repair their relationship, only to discover that the mysterious owner is hiding a deadly secret involving his hungry pet shark, Cinnamon.

title: Half Moon
overview: Riley and Lucy used to be close friends but have since grown apart over the years. While Lucy's long-term boyfriend is away at a bachelor party, she invites Riley to spend the weekend at her family's house upstate (now converted into an Airbnb), a trip they used to take together. Both live in New York, but haven't spent extended time together in years. Unspoken tensions surface as it becomes apparent how much distance there is between the two of them. Over the course of the weekend, they find small but unexpected ways to reconnect.

title: Seduced by an Amish Stranger
overview: A handsome young man arrives in an Amish community claiming to be homeless. He's taken in and treated with particular kindness by a widowed mother, but she soon discovers he isn't who he claims to be.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Mustang
overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.

title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
overview: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

title: Capturing Bigfoot
overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

title: The Ribbon
overview: She's just a regular teen who definitely ISN'T headless, if that's what you're wondering.

title: About Space and Depth
overview: An intimate and ongoing dialogue between filmmaker Paula Gaitán and Ken Jacobs.  Filmed over the last decade in New York, the documentary reveals Jacobs' thinking and presents previously unseen footage of Ken and his partner in life and art, Flo Jacobs.

title: Diversa
overview: The arrival of a young French female veterinarian in a small Southern Italian town triggers a long-planned revenge, exposing buried secrets and challenging deeply rooted prejudice.

title: Wicker
overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Coward
overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by tenderness, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

title: La Gradiva
overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

title: Karma
overview: In a village in northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Jeanne's six-year-old godson mysteriously disappears and Jeanne becomes the main suspect.

title: Hanging by a Wire
overview: On a Tuesday morning in August 2023, a group of kids set off for school, climbing into a makeshift cable car for the journey across a mountain pass in northwest Pakistan. What happened next would make headlines around the world. Suddenly, 900 feet above the ground, two cables snapped, putting the teenagers in mortal danger.

title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
overview: A celebration of the artist, songwriter, entertainer, humanitarian and entrepreneur whose music and generosity carried her from the mountains of east Tennessee into the hearts of generations around the world.

title: Paradise Lost
overview: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

title: Le Roi du Game
overview: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

title: The Navigator
overview: In 1980, Nainoa Thompson became the first Native Hawaiian in six centuries to navigate a voyaging canoe from Hawai'i to Tahiti without a compass or modern instruments. Nearly 50 years later, he embarks on the demanding open-ocean crossing one final time. He and a small crew of student navigators rely solely on the stars, nature's clues and lessons from the late master navigator Mau Piailug to guide them. As they sail 2,400 miles along the same sea road as their ancestors, they bear the responsibility of keeping this ancient knowledge alive. Naina sails not only to find an island but to search for something unseen. The Navigator reveals what is possible when we closely observe and deeply connect with the natural world.

title: Still Shining
overview: In the 1940s, Soon-ok and Jeong-eem dream of leaving home to chase music and freedom. But a sudden tragedy in the community shatters innocence, forcing Soon-ok into an unexpected marriage. Jeong-eem disappears under mysterious circumstances, leaving Soon-ok burdened with guilt and unanswered questions. Decades later, the elderly Soon-ok reunites with Jeong-eem, who remembers nothing of their past.

title: Tote Oma
overview: German Democratic Republic, 1989: Margot leads a quiet, orderly life with her party-loyal husband. Every day is the same between household chores, television and the same familiar rituals. In a world that promises her security and stability, the monotony of her daily life becomes increasingly noticeable. A young neighbor and a goldfish bring movement into Margot’s rigid routine.

title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
